# HR Metrics Handbook 2026

Issued by the Human Resources Department of Gamma Co., Ltd. on 12 January 2026. This handbook replaces the HR Metrics Handbook 2025.

## Employee turnover rate

Employee turnover rate is the number of employees who left voluntarily during the year divided by the average headcount for the year.

Formula: voluntary leavers in the year ÷ average headcount in the year.

## Results for 2025

The actual employee turnover rate for 2025 was 12.5%.
